dedupe_keys.name: attest t4 3 tool for state estimation of distribution networks

description: Hrvoje Keko publishes a standalone ATTEST T4.3 toolkit for preparing distribution-network state-estimation inputs. Zenodo offers one archive under EUPL 1.2. The own page says the full ATTEST task operates within a network-model access API, while this simplified release accepts a JSON IEC CIM node-breaker model. It follows switch states to build an admittance matrix and bus-branch representation for MATPOWER, and includes a rudimentary pseudo-load generator. These outputs can prepare power-flow or digital-twin cases from a distribution operator’s network model. No related catalogue parent explicitly covers this T4.3 module; ATTEST T4.1 and T4.2 are distinct procurement and activation tools. Geographic and time coverage depend on the supplied CIM model. A limitation is that the public description does not establish a complete measurement-based state estimator or implementation language in this simplified archive. The code was not downloaded, and matrix accuracy or switch handling was not tested.
